title: Guid.CreateSequentialGuid in AL
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 2 introduces Guid.CreateSequentialGuid, a new AL statement that generates sequential GUIDs instead of random ones, reducing index fragmentation and improving performance for GUID-based keys and systemId fields without requiring SQL roundtrips.
key_points: Guid.CreateSequentialGuid, new in Business Central 2025 Wave 2, produces consecutive GUIDs instead of the random ones from CreateGuid.
GUIDs are generated on the NST middle tier, so no extra roundtrip to SQL Server is needed.
The main benefit is fewer page splits and less index fragmentation; generation may also be slightly faster.
The author recommends replacing CreateGuid with CreateSequentialGuid in new or refactored code, since GUIDs are increasingly common in API-facing tables.
